text: APPROVE. The walk logic is unchanged: the file-cap break still falls through to subdirectory queuing, `TryList` records the same unread path when either listing call throws, and every `out` and parameter is assigned and used. `Files` now has only the `while`, its `&&`, and one nested `if`, so it should be well under 15. I couldn't build or run the analyzer here, so the build is judged from reading the diff, and the widened `CHA0004` pragma is paired with a `restore`.
